title.en: OpenAI API Key - Official Access, Models & Quick Overview | Get Model Key
title.zh: OpenAI API Key - 官方入口、模型与快速概览 | Get Model Key

description.en: Find the official OpenAI API key page, browse common OpenAI models, and see what OpenAI is best for.
description.zh: 查看 OpenAI 官方 API Key 入口、常用模型和适用场景。

en: OpenAI provides widely used GPT and reasoning models via the Platform API, with a mature SDK ecosystem and extensive documentation.
Typical use cases include chat, coding assistants, tool calling, and multimodal apps through platform.openai.com.
getModelKey is a directory: we link the official API keys page and do not sell, mint, or share OpenAI keys.
zh: OpenAI 通过 Platform API 提供广泛使用的 GPT 与推理模型，SDK 生态成熟、文档完善。
常见场景包括对话、编程助手、工具调用与多模态应用，入口在 platform.openai.com。
getModelKey 是目录站：只链到官方 API Keys 页面，不出售、不代开、不分享 OpenAI Key。

en: Visit https://platform.openai.com/api-keys and sign in to your OpenAI account.
Click create new secret key, name it, and copy the value before leaving the page.
Set usage limits in the Platform billing/settings area as needed, then call the official API with the key.
If the key leaks, revoke it immediately and create a replacement in the same UI.
zh: 访问 https://platform.openai.com/api-keys 并登录 OpenAI 账号。
创建新的 secret key，命名后离开页面前务必复制保存。
按需在 Platform 账单/设置中配置用量限制，再用该 Key 调用官方 API。
若泄露，请立即在同一界面吊销并重新创建。

question.en: Is a ChatGPT Plus subscription the same as an API key?
question.zh: ChatGPT Plus 订阅等于 API Key 吗？

answer.en: No. ChatGPT product plans and Platform API billing are separate. Create keys only on platform.openai.com.
answer.zh: 不是。ChatGPT 产品订阅与 Platform API 计费相互独立，请在 platform.openai.com 创建 Key。

question.en: Where should I read model and pricing details?

answer.en: Always use OpenAI’s official docs and pricing pages. getModelKey does not publish live prices.
answer.zh: 请以 OpenAI 官方文档与定价页为准。getModelKey 不公布实时价格。

question.en: Does this site sell OpenAI keys?
question.zh: 本站卖 OpenAI Key 吗？

answer.en: No. We only link official OpenAI pages so you can create keys yourself.
answer.zh: 不卖。我们只提供官方链接，请自行创建。
